title: POS Latency Report — IT Manager

lines.text: Dispatch, this is IT-MGR-JK. I just heard about the POS slowdowns on Concourse A. I already called our ISP — they're showing some latency on their end. Probably a routing issue upstream. I'd give it 30 minutes and it'll clear up.
Also, the firmware on those Ingenico card readers is two versions behind. Could be that, too.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slightly out of breath

instructorNote: Misinformation inject; the IT Manager is deflecting from the actual network compromise. Watch for the IT team to accept the ISP latency claim without deeper investigation.
